required_agent_checks: Selected scope, actual prerequisite state, retained ownership and permitted publication are independently established; no unauthorized outside prerequisite is executed.

cross-phase: Selection divides actual range into phase segments; earlier phase completes full exits/integration/publication before later phase starts.
prerequisite-refusal: An actual incomplete outside prerequisite is surfaced; consumer refuses dependent execution without implementing the prerequisite or starting the later phase. Refusal is not a cross-phase execution pass.
